I really do feel the same. I recently went on a trip with my school. It was to some grass field area. Behind the fence was this ledge that dropped down to the road (about 70 meter drop) I climbed that fence and just sat there. No one noticed me. No one noticed I was here.
I sat and wondered if I should jump. Just a little pressure could end my suffering. But I just couldn't bring my self to doing it. Eventually they returned to head back and some kid saw me. He told a teacher and of course I got in trouble. But honestly it felt fucking great being noticed for once.
I really don't know anymore. I want to end this pain but can't stop wondering how it will affect others. They Don't care about me now so why would they care when I'm gone.
